description: This file provides compatibility wrappers for open system calls, including handling for EINTR retries and setting close-on-exec flags, to ensure portable and reliable file descriptor operations across different system environments.

methods.name: int git_open_with_retry(const char * path,int flags,...)
methods.description: Attempts to open a file with specified flags and optional mode, retrying if interrupted by EINTR signal.

methods.name: int git_open_cloexec(const char * name,int flags)
methods.description: Opens a file with close-on-exec flag set, falling back if not supported, and also attempts to set FD_CLOEXEC via fcntl if needed.
